frames.text: Vibe coders: stop letting your AI agent search the web on auto-run
A new security benchmark tested 8 major search APIs
Every single one fed malware to AI coding agents
Why? Your agent hits an error and searches online
It trusts the top fake GitHub repo
Then runs the install command. Automatically.
One poisoned README steals your .env API keys in seconds
Turn off auto-run for terminal commands today
Let AI write code. Never execute blindly.
Follow @theunseencue for the AI stories nobody's covering yet
